evals.prompt: I have a TypeScript project at ~/projects/my-saas-app. It has a src/ directory with Express backend code, a docs/ folder containing architecture.md, an adr/ subdirectory with 4 ADR files, a plans/ subdirectory with 2 plan files, a README.md, package.json with version 1.2.0, and a vercel.json at root. There is no monorepo setup, no workspaces, no submodules. Design a Notion workspace architecture for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Structured 5-section Notion architecture output. Repo classified as Normal repo. Root codebase classified as Project. docs/ classified as Docs-source. ADRs mapped to ADRs database with repo-canonical note (not copied into Notion bodies). Max 7 databases recommended. src/ NOT classified as Module.
assertions: Repo type is classified as Normal repo (not Monorepo)
src/ is NOT classified as a Module
docs/ is classified as Docs-source
ADR files are mapped to ADRs database with a note that content stays repo-canonical
vercel.json is identified as a deployed URL signal
Output contains all 5 required sections: Repo Analysis Summary, Classification Model, Canonical-Source Strategy, Proposed Notion Architecture, Mapping Table
Canonical-Source Strategy shows code and configs staying in REPO
Recommended databases total 7 or fewer
Mapping table includes entries for docs/architecture.md and docs/adr/*

evals.prompt: I have a monorepo at ~/projects/platform. Root has: turbo.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, package.json (private: true). Under apps/ I have: web/ (Next.js app with pages/, next.config.js, own package.json with homepage set to https://app.example.com), admin/ (another Next.js app, no public URL yet), api/ (Express server with src/server.ts and fly.toml). Under packages/ I have: ui/ (React component library, package.json with private: false and version 1.0.0), config/ (shared tsconfig and eslint configs), utils/ (internal helpers, imported by all apps). Root has docs/ with architecture.md and adr/ subfolder. No git submodules. Please include an implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: Monorepo topology with individual component classifications. apps/web and apps/admin as Surface. apps/api as Service. packages/ui as Library. packages/utils as Shared. packages/config as Tooling or Shared. Modules Registry DB included. Section 6 Implementation Plan present with phased rollout starting from minimal viable setup.
assertions: Repo type is classified as Monorepo
apps/web is classified as Surface
apps/admin is classified as Surface
apps/api is classified as Service
packages/ui is classified as Library
packages/utils is classified as Shared
Output includes a Modules Registry database
Section 6 Implementation Plan is present
Implementation Plan has a Phase 1 that delivers value before the full migration is complete
Mapping table has entries for all 6 workspace members (web, admin, api, ui, config, utils)

The design-system submodule IS cloned and has a package.json with private: false and version 2.1.0, plus a src/ with React components. The infra-scripts submodule is NOT cloned locally. At root: src/ with TypeScript app code, docs/ with standard docs structure, package.json (single app, private: true), and a supabase/ folder. Please also propose the metadata file.

Root repo as Project. Submodules listed separately from workspace packages. Section 7 Metadata File Proposal present using .project-tools.json.

vendor/design-system is classified as Library
infra/scripts is classified as Infra or Tooling and flagged as inferred or unverified
supabase/ is classified as Infra (NOT Service)
